name: repo-guardian
description: Repository health checks and local rule enforcement: CI presence, LF and .gitattributes, credentials and build artifacts kept out of the repo, the pre-commit self-check, forbidden commands, emoji and temp-file placement, plus code and comment rule lint after every write.

description_i18n.en: Repository health checks and local rule enforcement: CI presence, LF and .gitattributes, credentials and build artifacts kept out of the repo, the pre-commit self-check, forbidden commands, emoji and temp-file placement, plus code and comment rule lint after every write.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 仓库健康检查与本机规则执行：CI 有无、LF 与 .gitattributes、凭据与构建产物不入库、提交前自查、禁用命令、emoji 与临时文件落点，以及写入后的代码与注释规范核对。
